In February 2026, the Company announced Project Catalyst, a comprehensive operational and efficiency plan.

As part of Project Catalyst, the Board of Directors approved plans to shut down the Company's Fieldsboro, New Jersey site and decommission select assets at its Elwood, Illinois (Millsdale) and Stalybridge, U.K. facilities during the first half of 2026.

On July 28, 2026, the Company's Board of Directors approved a plan (as part of Project Catalyst) to reduce the Company’s global salaried workforce by around 100 roles, or seven percent of global salaried headcount.
The Company estimates that it will incur $4.0 million to $6.0 million of charges in connection with the workforce reduction, consisting primarily of employee severance, benefits and related costs.
The Company expects substantially all of these workforce reduction charges to result in cash expenditures.
The Company expects to recognize the majority of these charges prior to the end of 2026.
The Company anticipates recognizing total restructuring expenses in the range of $77.0 million to $80.0 million for full year 2026.
See Note 16, Business Restructuring, of the notes to the Company's condensed consolidated financial statements (included in Item 1 of this Form 10-Q) for more details about Project Catalyst.
For 2026, the Company estimates that total capital expenditures will be in the range of $100.0 million to $105.0 million.
The Company will continue to invest in the equipment and facilities necessary to comply with existing and future regulations.
During the first nine months of 2026 and 2025, the Company’s expenditures for capital projects related to environmental matters were $2.5 million and $7.2 million, respectively.
